api: TreeModelListener.treeNodesChanged for children of the root while the root is hidden (JTree.setRootVisible(false); BasicTreeUI forwards the event)
stock_behaviour: The changed children get new sizes but the rows that follow keep their old y origins, so rows overlap or leave gaps (getRowBounds, getPathBounds, getClosestRowForLocation, getPreferredSize and painting) until something else recomputes the y origins. Reproduced by both differentials, for example M3TreeLayoutCacheDifferential seed 21 step 115 (stock row 9 y 151, previous row ends at 148) and M3JTreeViewportDifferential seed 104 step 129 (two-line HTML label changed to one line: stock row 1 y 40, row 0 ends at 20).
m3_behaviour: Rows keep exact y origins: the M3 cache keeps no stored y origins; y is the Fenwick prefix sum of the cached heights.
cause_stock_file_line: src/java.desktop/share/classes/javax/swing/tree/VariableHeightLayoutCache.java:436-440 (treeNodesChanged calls updateYLocationsFrom only when changedNode.getRow() != -1; the hidden root's row is -1)
javadoc_or_contract_quote: AbstractLayoutCache.getBounds: "Returns a rectangle giving the bounds needed to draw path." BasicTreeUI paints every row at the bounds the cache returns.
differential_acceptance: Accepted only right after a treeNodesChanged event whose parent is the root, only when the root is hidden and row heights vary, only when the stock rows are then inconsistent (a row's y differs from the previous row's y + height) and the M3 rows are not. Both caches are then re-synchronized through public API (layout cache: invalidatePathBounds of row 0; JTree: setCellRenderer) and the script continues. Counted per run.

api: TreeSelectionModel.resetRowSelection, called by every layout cache after a row change
stock_behaviour: insureRowContinuity throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException when the selection holds a path whose row is -1 (not visible) and an earlier row gap exists: newSel[selectionIndex[i] - min] with selectionIndex[i] == -1. The exception escapes the layout cache call; the stock cache is then left part-way (its treeNodesInserted and treeNodesRemoved call resetRowSelection before they update the y origins of the following rows).
m3_behaviour: Same exception, thrown at the same point of the same operation. Not fixed in this leaf (the defect is in DefaultTreeSelectionModel). Afterwards the M3 rows have exact y origins where the stock rows keep stale ones.
javadoc_or_contract_quote: TreeSelectionModel.resetRowSelection: "Updates this object's mapping from TreePaths to rows. This should be invoked when the mapping from TreePaths to integers has changed (for example, a node has been expanded)." Nothing allows it to throw.
differential_acceptance: The differential compares the exception class (both must throw the same). After any exception escapes a cache call, both selections are cleared and both caches rebuilt with setModel, and the script continues. Counted per run (D2 when the top frame is DefaultTreeSelectionModel, other otherwise).
